name: Kinetic-Anchor Bimetric Slip (KABS): Massive-Graviton Frame with e^-y Screened PF and Independent Stiff-Vector Kinetic
claimed_mechanism: This architecture exits the single-metric class by introducing a second dynamical metric (f_munu) to generate a massive graviton sector. The massive graviton's spatial gradient provides the necessary off-ray lensing carrier to evade the DC-013 slip-lock theorem, replacing the unremovable local preferred-frame A_0 requirement. The MOND force law is implemented via the auxiliary-Legendre chi, while the preferred-frame coupling to the stiff vector u_mu is strictly screened by e^-y. Crucially, the u_mu kinetic term carries an independent, unscreened normalization constant, decoupling the PPN-visible screened response from the propagating mode's kinetic anchor (resolving the P7 collision).
predicted_weak_field: In the weak-field limit, the massive graviton sector mediates a Yukawa-suppressed slip between Phi and Psi, but the spatial gradient of the massive mode contributes an O(eps^2) stress tensor that cancels the under-lensing inherent to the frame-free scalar sector. The stiff vector u_mu provides the preferred-frame carrier, but its coupling to matter is suppressed by e^-y, ensuring alpha_1, alpha_2 ~ e^-y in the high-acceleration limit. Because the kinetic normalization of u_mu is independent of the screening factor, the mode remains finite and healthy in the Solar System, avoiding the strong-coupling wall that killed the khronometric MOND.
inequivalence_argument: This candidate is structurally distinct from all dead classes. It is not DC-001/DC-013 because it uses a genuine second dynamical metric (bimetric) rather than a single metric, and the massive graviton provides a spatial-gradient lensing carrier that evades the diff-invariance slip-lock. It is not DC-002/DC-009 (AeST) because the preferred-frame coupling is strictly screened by e^-y, avoiding the constant K_B alpha_2 kill. It is not DC-010 (khronometric) because the kinetic normalization of the preferred-frame vector is independent of the screening factor, directly addressing the P7 strong-coupling wound. It is not DC-011/DC-012 because it relies on a local massive-graviton sector for lensing rather than a nonlocal F+ kernel, avoiding the empty scale-split window.
